name: Belmond Hotel Splendido Mare
insider_take: This intimate harbourside gem transforms a row of 16th-century fishermen's houses into one of the Italian Riviera's most coveted retreats, where La Dolce Vita meets seaside sophistication.
whats_special: Located directly on Portofino's legendary piazzetta, this boutique property offers unparalleled front-row seats to the harbor's daily theater of superyachts and colorful facades. The hotel's Chuflay Bar serves the signature Bellini cocktail in the very region where it was perfected, while the DaV Mare restaurant boasts Michelin-recommended cuisine with tables literally steps from the Mediterranean.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room and time your arrival for aperitivo hour (6-8 PM) when the piazzetta comes alive with yacht crews, locals, and the golden light that made Portofino a favorite of Hollywood legends like Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton.
dont_miss: The short boat ride to sister property Hotel Splendido for sunset cocktails on their legendary terrace, and the 20-minute hike to Chiesa di San Giorgio for panoramic views over the Ligurian coast that inspired countless artists and writers, including Guy de Maupassant who called Portofino "the most beautiful place on earth."
pros: Prime waterfront location directly on Portofino's iconic harbor
Authentic Italian Riviera charm with elegant seaside accommodations
Exceptional Mediterranean cuisine with harbor views
Exclusive access to private beach and water activities
cons: Limited accessibility due to historic waterfront building design
Seasonal operation typically May through October
